lines.4: 「Still no polite title, huh? Oh well. (And no comeback about it being nighttime...)」
lines.5: 「Here, cake from Sabatini in Aoyama. It's amazing, so share it with Nodoka.」
lines.7: 「Oh, really? Then I'll deliver it straight to your house.」
lines.8: 「Come on, let's go home. It's too late for a girl to be walking around alone.」
lines.9: 「Hmm... Still won't open up to me?」
lines.10: 「But I'll never give up. I'll come again.」
lines.13: Everything in the world outside the line looked meaningless.
